depiction.primary_object: film clapperboard with striped top bar
modifiers: diagonal slash from top-left to bottom-right
depiction.composition: single object in front view crossed by a diagonal strike-through

readings.meaning: delete, cut, or omit video clip or scene

ambiguity: At very small sizes, the striped top bar of the clapperboard mixed with the diagonal slash can resemble a crossed-out calendar, folder, or mail envelope.

reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a movie clapperboard crossed out with a diagonal slash, meaning no video/movies or canceling/deleting video content. It fits tasks like canceling streaming subscriptions, deleting video footage, cutting scenes in video editing, or refunding cinema tickets, though at tiny sizes the striped clapper bar and slash can look slightly busy.
